enrichment.core_claim: Near-death experiences can catalyze human development, and an integrative coaching model using multiple intelligences helps integrate them into everyday life.
enrichment.ask_question: What were the hardest parts of integrating your own NDE into daily life, and how does coaching help others with that?
enrichment.challenge_question: How would you evaluate whether the PIERS coaching model works better than ordinary supportive counseling for experiencers?
